checked.found: 599 BCE is the traditional date accepted by both Jain sects (Wikipedia); modern scholars place him 50-100 years later. Deck notes ask for the traditional date.

Composition date is disputed. Wikipedia lists the 4th century BCE; linguistic studies point to the late 4th or early 3rd century BCE; Guodian slips date before 300 BCE. -400 is at the early edge of the range and no source gives it.

Kalinga war is dated c. 261 BCE by most sources (some say 262 or 260). The conversion's timing is debated (possibly gradual, or earlier per minor rock edicts), but the traditional account ties it to the war's aftermath, matching the name.
Sources consistently date Zhang Daoling's vision of the deified Laozi and the movement's founding in Sichuan to 142 CE (traditional account).
Kojiki presented to Empress Genmei in 712 CE; oldest surviving Japanese book.
788 CE is the most widely cited scholarly date; some scholars argue c. 700 and traditions give much earlier. Born in Kerala (Kalady).
Nichiren first chanted Nam-myoho-renge-kyo publicly at Seicho-ji on 28 April 1253.
Ganden Monastery founded by Tsongkhapa in 1409.
Born 15 April 1469 at Nankana Sahib, Punjab.
Altan Khan conferred the title Dalai on Sonam Gyatso in 1578; Dalai means ocean.
Guru Arjan compiled the Adi Granth in 1604 and installed it at Harmandir Sahib, Amritsar.
Shinbutsu bunri orders issued from 1868 by the Meiji government, followed by haibutsu kishaku attacks on temples.
